label: Bible Study
prompt: I was eyes to the blind, and feet was I to the _____.
verse: I was eyes to the blind, and feet was I to the lame.
note: Job remembers better days — he was eyes for the blind and feet for the lame.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: For ye are all the _____ of God by faith in Christ Jesus.
verse: For ye are all the children of God by faith in Christ Jesus.
note: Faith is the family resemblance: Paul says all who believe are children of God.

label: Sunday School
prompt: So when they had dined, Jesus saith to Simon Peter, Simon, son of Jonas, lovest thou me more than these? He saith unto him, Yea, Lord; thou knowest that I love thee. He saith unto him, Feed my _____.
verse: So when they had dined, Jesus saith to Simon Peter, Simon, son of Jonas, lovest thou me more than these? He saith unto him, Yea, Lord; thou knowest that I love thee. He saith unto him, Feed my lambs.
note: Breakfast on the beach, then a question for Peter — and a job: 'Feed my lambs.'

label: Deep Water
prompt: Woe to them that are at _____ in Zion, and trust in the mountain of Samaria, which are named chief of the nations, to whom the house of Israel came!
verse: Woe to them that are at ease in Zion, and trust in the mountain of Samaria, which are named chief of the nations, to whom the house of Israel came!
note: Amos's woe to the comfortable elite of Samaria, lounging on ivory beds while the nation decayed.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: Be of the same mind one toward another. Mind not high things, but _____ to men of low estate. Be not wise in your own conceits.
verse: Be of the same mind one toward another. Mind not high things, but condescend to men of low estate. Be not wise in your own conceits.
note: 'Condescend to men of low estate' — in KJV English a good thing: stoop gladly to fellowship with the lowly.
